svg.title: Single-stream decode speed, megakernel vs stock kernels, boot by boot
svg.desc: Dot plot of single-stream decode speed in tokens per second on 4×B300 nodes, one row per boot, each request a small dot and the boot's average a large one. Speed gate bench, node 1, 8 requests per boot: with stock kernels (megakernel off) the boot averaged 615.3, its requests 567.0 to 657.3; the two megakernel boots averaged 885.8 (+44.0%) and 849.0 (+38.0%), 867.4 together (+41.0%), their requests 783.5 to 957.9, so every megakernel request beat every stock one. Decode test, a separate bench, 14 megakernel boots on two nodes: boot averages 840.9 to 906.7, averaging 870.2; first code version 8 boots averaging 875.6, second 6 boots averaging 863.0. Pooled over its 208 requests, the 10th percentile is 784.6, the median 865.2, the 90th percentile 954.0 and the fastest request 1,063.8; 5 passed 1,000 tokens per second, marked by a reference line.
